assets.alt_text: Beekeeper in protective clothing carrying out powdered-sugar Varroa monitoring with a bee-sample container and collection tray
assets.caption: Monitoring in practice. This field example shows a beekeeper using a powdered-sugar method to sample for Varroa while wearing protective clothing. It illustrates one real monitoring workflow, not a universal preference for one sampling method; colony ID, method, date, sample size and result still need to be recorded.
